channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Naz Reid | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Naz Reid from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Naz Reid
item.description:
Spurs head coach Mitch Johnson said.

“Not in terms of hitting Naz Reid, I want to be very clear about that. I'm glad Naz Reid is okay... but [Wemby's] going to have to protect himself if [the refs] are not.”

Mitch Johnson on Naz Reid, May 11, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Chris Finch on Naz Reid
item.description:
‪Jon Krawczynski‬:Chris Finch on Naz Reid:

“Naz’s game today was awesome. That’s two games in a row it looks like he’s back a little bit more like himself. He found his touch. I really liked how he made a lot of gritty plays defensively.”

Chris Finch on Naz Reid, Apr 9, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Nickeil Alexander-Walker
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Tim Connelly on Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Naz Reid and Julius Randle:

“We’re very appreciative of what the market might look like. We’re pretty cautiously optimistic we’re in a good place with all of the guys. Most importantly, they want to be here.”

Tim Connelly on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Jun 2, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Suns coach Mike Budenholzer on strategy with Rudy Gobert (back) out:

“Hopefully our guys are aggressive. If there's opportunities to get to the paint, finish. Opportunities on the offensive boards. If it's (Julius) Randle and (Naz) Reid or whoever their backup bigs are, make them have to move and guard the pick-and-roll. Just be aggressive, attacking, just generally speaking but also make an effort to get to the offensive boards some too.”

Mike Budenholzer on Julius Randle, Naz Reid, Rudy Gobert, Mar 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Naz Reid
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Anthony Edwards on Naz Reid's jersey retirement:

“That was the best feeling I had in a minute,since having my little girl. It felt like my jersey was getting retired. Naz is like a brother to me.”

Anthony Edwards on Naz Reid, Jan 18, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: DaRon Holmes on Al Horford, Draymond Green, Aaron Gordon, Nikola Jokic, Naz Reid
item.description:
DaRon Holmes:

“I like guys like Naz Reid, Al Horford, Nikola Jokic and Aaron Gordon. I take different things from different guys. Defensively, Draymond Green because he’s not the biggest, fastest, or strongest, but he’s smart. He knows how to play in pick-and-roll coverage and uses his mouth to be vocal.”

DaRon Holmes on Al Horford, Draymond Green, Aaron Gordon, Nikola Jokic, Naz Reid, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Naz Reid
item.description:
Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Naz Reid's 6MOY:

“The impact he’s had for his career, to honestly get better every year, being undrafted, it’s kind of what you dream of as a kid. I’m happy he was able to get that. Great person.”

Nickeil Alexander-Walker on Naz Reid, Apr 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Naz Reid
item.description:
Dane Moore:Anthony Edwards on Naz Reid, who had 21 tonight (2/5 from 3, 6/6 from 2):

“KAT got in foul trouble and once again Naz comes in and fuckin plays incredible again. Once again, he saves us.”

Anthony Edwards on Naz Reid, Dec 30, 2023. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Mike Conley on Naz Reid
item.description:
Dane Moore:Mike Conley on playing w/ Naz Reid:

“I love Naz. Naz’s game makes our job as a PG super, super easy. His ability to shoot, guys have to bring two defenders to the ball-handler most times. And if he’s passing, it’s an easy release to him… His skill set is one that not many bigs have”

Mike Conley on Naz Reid, Mar 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Naz Reid
item.description:
Edwards on Naz Reid:

“I just told him in the locker room, I said, ‘You nice, Naz. You nice.’I don’t think I have that in me to come in a game when I haven’t played the entire game, to come in the fourth quarter and I go 5 for 7 and score 14 points.”

Anthony Edwards on Naz Reid, Oct 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.
